name: Budesonide-formoterol
summary: A controller inhaler that combines anti-inflammatory steroid effect with long-acting bronchodilation, and in some strategies can also serve as a reliever.
good: Patients who need both inflammation control and bronchodilation.
bad: Incorrect inhaler technique or a plan that uses it as a replacement for all asthma education.
clinicalPearls: It pairs anti-inflammatory control with bronchodilator relief in one inhaler.
mechanism: Budesonide reduces airway inflammation while formoterol provides long-acting beta-2 bronchodilation.
indications: Asthma controller therapy and selected COPD regimens; in some asthma plans it also functions as maintenance-and-reliever therapy.
interactionNotes: Overuse of bronchodilator component, other sympathomimetics, and poor inhaler technique can reduce benefit.

warnings: Oral candidiasis, hoarseness, tremor, and tachycardia can occur.
